---

A metasystemic change changes the structure that organizes the project. It changes the lens, not only the picture. It is slower and needs more care. See [the constitution](../../metasystemic/CONSTITUTION.md) and [GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md).

## Proposal

What should change. Be specific.

## Reason

Why. What problem this solves or what it makes clearer.

## Bias-impact note

How this change affects what the data shows or hides. Categories, labels, order, defaults, and missing data all carry bias. Name the risk you can see.

## Migration plan

How we move from the current structure to the new one. What gets updated, in what order.

## Rollback plan

How we undo this if it does not work.

## Affected layer

- [ ] Tabs
- [ ] Governance
- [ ] Visual grammar
- [ ] Agent interface
- [ ] Constitution

## Requires a vote?

- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No

A vote is required for adding, removing, renaming, or reordering a canonical tab, for changing the public meaning of canonical tabs, for changing the constitution, voting rights, or maintainer powers. See [GOVERNANCE.md](../../GOVERNANCE.md).

## Discussion period

A proposal stays open for at least 14 days before a vote. During that time, contributors may ask for data, alternatives, risks, and examples.
